description: A ranked P1-P3 action queue to grow organic traffic from existing pages (consolidate, fix snippets, recover declines, fix indexing, add internal links) with a transparent score, exact steps and impact split into measured numbers and labelled estimates. Uses your connected Google Search Console (read-only) plus a crawl of the site; the analysis is reused for a day. Never changes your site: redirects are proposals only. Needs an API key from a paid plan.
